description: A footpath runs south along the barren headland of Cape Matapan, with open sea on both sides, toward a small white lighthouse at the tip. A few low stones lie near the path. They are not a standing temple. Cloud cover is about 65%, about 20.9°C, wind about 18 km/h. A small light shows at the lantern. Its flash for this hour was not confirmed.
